note.zh-TW: 0-2 的投資內容放在延伸區，名詞卡附「非投資建議」聲明。
note.en: The investment material from the 0-2 slides sits in the extension area, and the card carries a not-investment-advice statement.

definition.zh-TW: 股價是每股盈餘的幾倍，也就是市場願意為每一份獲利付多少錢。倍數越高表示市場預期越樂觀或股價越貴；每股盈餘小於或等於零時不適用。
definition.en: The share price as a multiple of earnings per share: how much the market pays for each unit of profit. A higher multiple means more optimistic expectations or a dearer share; it does not apply when earnings per share are zero or negative.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義本益比；股價是輸入值，每股盈餘的定義依 IAS 33。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define the price-to-earnings ratio; the share price is an input and earnings per share follow IAS 33.
